subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin support delegated user OAuth, and if so which identity model and operations may use it alongside service-account app authentication?
rationale: This is a new credential and capability surface with security, operator, and compatibility consequences; source evidence alone cannot choose the permanent product contract.

options.title: Sponsor delegated user OAuth
options.body: Define a plugin-owned refresh-token or domain-wide-delegation contract for reactions, native uploads, and proactive DMs while retaining service-account webhook handling.

options.title: Keep app-auth-only
options.body: Retain the current service-account model and pursue graceful text-link/media degradation rather than delegated user capabilities.

options.title: Externalize the capability
options.body: Decide that user-identity Google Chat behavior should be delivered by an external plugin after verifying current plugin seams are sufficient.

recommendation.title: Sponsor delegated user OAuth
recommendation.body: Define a plugin-owned refresh-token or domain-wide-delegation contract for reactions, native uploads, and proactive DMs while retaining service-account webhook handling.

likelyOwner.reason: The earlier maintainer-side review retained this issue specifically for this unresolved product and security boundary.
